---
title: "Ballpark Dimensions & Factors Dataset"
subtitle: "Explore all 810 ballpark-season observations from MLB Baseball Savant (2018–2026)"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(DT)

parks <- fromJSON("data/park_dimensions_factors.json") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(
    Season = season,
    Ballpark = venue_name,
    Team = team,
    League = league,
    Split = split,
    `HR Factor` = index_hr,
    `Runs Factor` = index_runs,
    `Avg Fence Dist (ft)` = avg_fence_distance,
    `LF Line (ft)` = distance_lf_line,
    `CF (ft)` = distance_cf,
    `RF Line (ft)` = distance_rf_line,
    `Max Wall (ft)` = height_highest,
    `Elevation (ft)` = elevation,
    Roof = roof
  )
```

::: {.glass-card}
```{r}
#| label: table-view
#| echo: false

datatable(
  parks,
  extensions = c("Buttons", "Responsive"),
  options = list(
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    pageLength = 15,
    searchHighlight = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  ),
  filter = "top",
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = "compact stripe hover"
)
```
:::
